mechanism_narrative: When monthly consumer demand proxy GDPC1 exceeds 13,000 billion chained 2017 dollars, S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days tend to be positive due to anticipated corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: In 20-day windows following GDPC1 > 13,000, SPX 20d returns are not statistically different from zero (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in employment (PAYEMS) of more than 100,000 jobs correlates with a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days as labor market strength supports corporate optimism.
failure_condition: Over 30 consecutive 5-day windows with PAYEMS > +100,000, average 5d SPX returns are negative (mean < 0).

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index crosses above 2.0%, the S&P 500 shows a negative 20-day forward return as investors anticipate rate hikes to curb inflation.
failure_condition: In 20-day windows following CPIAUCSL > 200, SPX 20d returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly expansion in industrial production (INDPRO) above 100 (index 2017=100) predicts a positive S&P 500 forward return over 60 days as it signals economic resilience and demand recovery.
failure_condition: Over 10 consecutive 60-day windows with INDPRO > 100, average 60d SPX returns are non-positive (mean <= 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in both consumer demand (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) above their 12-month moving averages create a positive interaction that drives a 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: In 20-day windows where both GDPC1 and HOUST are above their 12mo moving averages, SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive (Rank IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 5%, the S&P 500 exhibits a positive 60-day forward return as labor market tightness supports corporate hiring and growth.
failure_condition: During 3 consecutive 60-day periods with UNRATE < 5, average 60d SPX returns are flat or negative (mean <= 0).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 1 percentage point in a single month is associated with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as higher borrowing costs dampen equity valuations.
failure_condition: In 20-day windows following a >1pp FEDFUNDS jump, SPX 20d returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a regime of falling industrial production (INDPRO) for two consecutive months, the S&P 500 shows a higher 5-day forward return as market anticipates a bottoming-out and potential rebound.
failure_condition: Over 10 consecutive 5-day windows with INDPRO in decline, average 5d SPX returns are negative (mean < 0).
